validation_rules.proper_yale_compact_all30: Zero new exact-text first9 losses against baseline, for each of three histories.
validation_rules.nasal_and_ordinary_controls: Zero new exact-text first9 losses on validation nasal/ordinary controls across all four primary/diagnostic forms, per history.
validation_rules.habitual_ng_fresh10: Candidate first9 hit count minus baseline first9 hit count at least2.
validation_rules.habitual_ng_learned10: Candidate first9 hit count at least baseline first9 count for each short/heavy history; all individual losses remain reported.

contract_rules.strict_modes: Type-independent serialized first90 candidate pools and page metadata identical for both strict Jyutping forms, all60 cases and all histories.
contract_rules.disabled_behavior: Explicitly disabled candidate must match baseline pools/page metadata on all260 fresh requests.
contract_rules.runtime: Zero exceptions, invalid page/reading metadata, consumption mismatches, nonfinite scores, duplicate texts or lookup history mutations.
contract_rules.source_guards: Fixture, candidate, baseline, runtime/data, runner and this policy must retain their recorded SHA256 after the run.
contract_rules.history_identity: Create each learned history once through actual baseline record_selection, preserve old ng4 seed reading and clone identical bytes per model/profile. Never seed models independently.

scope: Untouched-within-cycle validation only, not representative human input or held-out language accuracy. These are incremental feature gates, not the previously failed90% sentence release gates.
